# S57 Test Cell

`US4NJ1DG.zip` is an unchanged NOAA ENC exchange set downloaded on 2026-10-08
from https://www.charts.noaa.gov/ENCs/US4NJ1DG.zip (39,538 bytes).

It is used only for deterministic S57 import/display regression tests; it is
not bundled as an operational chart. Source and usage information:
https://www.charts.noaa.gov/ENCs/ENC_Agreement.shtml

The simulator's simplified portrayal is not an S-52-certified ECDIS and must
not be used for navigation.
